elsewhere.note: But Yahweh has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.
(for they are your people, and your inheritance, which you brought out of Egypt, from the middle of the iron furnace);
The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.
Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver. I have chosen you in the furnace of affliction.
